ABOUT_DESCRIPTION: Hi! I'm Higor Stanley, a Systems Development student and junior developer. I'm bilingual (Brazilian Portuguese and English) and have experience with C#, Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript. I mainly focus on building web applications and keep creating projects to expand my learning and portfolio.

ABOUT_TIMELINE_04_DESCRIPTION: Building my personal portfolio website with Angular, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript to showcase my projects and skills, aiming to reach more people and opportunities in tech.
